ADAPT (gMG): treatment within-cycle analysis — IgG reduction and MG-ADL scores measured during the 4-week dosing cycle. Q1W×4 then re-cycle. ~$1.7B 2024 revenue. 20+ indication pipeline. ADAPT-Forward (combinations) exploring next-generation use. Class-defining first-in-class asset; sets the Q1W×4 dosing burden that Ailux's Q6–8W target directly addresses.

Vivacity-MG3 Ph3: treatment policy estimand (MG-ADL responders regardless of rescue medication). Best approved dosing: Q2W continuous. FDA approved Jan 2025. SC formulation in development. IgG subclass-specific depletion. Broad indication pipeline (6+ active Ph3s). Ailux must beat Q2W — target is Q6–8W.

MycarinG (gMG): within-treatment estimand. SC 7mg/kg Q1W — validated SC route and self-administration at home in gMG. Approved 2023. Q1W burden remains despite SC convenience. Primary value: validated SC administration in gMG — de-risks Ailux's SC administration strategy.

IMVT-1402 MAD cohort: 74% IgG reduction (Q1W×4, 600mg). No albumin depletion, no LDL elevation. Phase 2/3 ongoing in 5 indications. Sets the efficacy benchmark for the class at Q1W: ≥70% IgG depletion at trough. Ailux must achieve equivalent depletion at 6-8× the dosing interval.
